content.user_title: Create AI Avatar Videos with RunComfy
content.value_statement: Creating lip-synced avatar videos often requires choosing the right model and input format. This skill routes requests to RunComfy models and provides ready CLI invocations.
actual_capabilities: Routes avatar requests across OmniHuman, Wan 2-7, Wan 2-2 Animate, HappyHorse, and Seedance v2 Pro.
Prepares RunComfy CLI invocations with the correct model endpoint and input fields.
Selects workflows for portrait plus audio, script-only video, stylized characters, and cinematic monologues.
Provides prompt patterns for spoken scripts, audio tone, camera framing, and reference media.
Documents consent guidance, token storage behavior, endpoint scope, and generated file limits.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and a signed-in account or API token.
Sends prompts and referenced media URLs to RunComfy model APIs.
Depends on accessible image and audio URLs for most avatar workflows.
Cannot guarantee exact lip sync, identity preservation, or voice quality for every model.

use_cases.title: Produce Product Presenter Clips
use_cases.description: Create short UGC-style videos from a presenter portrait and a clean voiceover file.

use_cases.title: Localize Brand Videos
use_cases.description: Generate multiple dubbed clips from the same portrait by changing the audio track.

use_cases.title: Animate Stylized Characters
use_cases.description: Choose character-focused or cinematic models for mascots, illustrated subjects, and reference-driven scenes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Avatar Clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with one portrait and one voiceover file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an AI avatar video from this portrait URL and this voiceover URL. Choose the best RunComfy model and give me the command to run.

prompt_templates.title: Turn a Script into Video
prompt_templates.scenario: User has text but no recorded audio file.
prompt_templates.prompt: I only have this short script. Pick a RunComfy route that can generate speech in the video and format a concise prompt for a vertical talking-head clip.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Lip-Sync Routes
prompt_templates.scenario: User needs model selection advice before generating.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the RunComfy avatar routes for this project. Explain which model fits a photoreal portrait, a stylized character, and a cinematic monologue.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Asset Campaign
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow with subject references, voice tracks, and multiple deliverables.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a three-video avatar campaign using my reference subject, voice tracks, aspect ratios, and brand tone. Select models and provide generation steps for each deliverable.

output_examples.input: I have a presenter portrait and a clean voiceover file for a 15-second product intro.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends OmniHuman, explains why portrait plus audio fits, and returns a RunComfy command with image and audio inputs.

output_examples.input: I need a mascot to say a scripted welcome line, but I do not have a recorded voice file.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends HappyHorse for script-driven generation and gives a short prompt that quotes the spoken line clearly.

output_examples.input: I want a cinematic monologue using a subject photo, voice reference, and widescreen framing.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Seedance v2 Pro, maps each reference asset to its role, and suggests lens, lighting, and motion language.

best_practices: Confirm rights to the subject likeness and speaker voice before generating avatar videos.
Use clean voiceover audio and clear portrait framing for stronger lip sync.
Keep spoken scripts short and test one clip before generating a full sequence.
anti_patterns: Do not animate or imitate real people without consent.
Do not use mixed music beds when precise mouth sync matters.
Do not choose cinematic multi-reference models for simple portrait plus audio jobs.

faq.question: Does this skill create video files directly?
faq.answer: It prepares and runs RunComfy CLI commands. RunComfy performs the model generation and downloads outputs to the chosen directory.

faq.question: Which model is the default choice?
faq.answer: OmniHuman is the default for a portrait image plus a separate voiceover audio file.

faq.question: Can it work without an audio file?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can route script-only requests to HappyHorse, which generates speech during video creation.

faq.question: Can it animate illustrated characters?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes Wan 2-2 Animate for stylized or illustrated characters with audio-driven motion.

faq.question: What inputs should I prepare?
faq.answer: Prepare accessible image and audio URLs, or provide a short script when using a script-driven route.

faq.question: What safety checks should users apply?
faq.answer: Users should verify consent for likeness and voice use, avoid impersonation, and disclose synthetic media when required.
